name: What features should I include in caregiver living quarters?

mainEntity.name: What features should I include in caregiver living quarters?

acceptedAnswer.text: Caregiver quarters benefit from practical accessibility features that make assisting your loved one safer and less physically demanding. Key bathroom upgrades include curbless walk-in showers with grab bars, comfort-height toilets, and slip-resistant flooring. Throughout the living quarters, wider doorways and level thresholds ensure smooth movement for walkers or wheelchairs. Installing sound-dampening drywall helps both the caregiver and the family maintain acoustic privacy and rest. It is also wise to include dedicated storage for medical equipment and direct exterior or interior pathways that avoid disruptive household traffic during late-night care checks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Essential features include private bathrooms with curbless walk-in showers, wider doorways, sound-dampening drywall, accessible storage, and easy access to care recipients.
